title: RNA Extraction from Wheat Stigmas Stored in DNA/RNA Shield
author: Marina Millán Blánquez

steps.title: Homogenize Wheat Stigmas
steps.instruction: Homogenize the wheat stigmas preserved in DNA/RNA Shield solution.

substeps.instruction: Add two steel ball bearings into each Eppendorf tube containing samples preserved in DNA/RNA Shield solution (~200 μL for five stigmas at Waddington stage 10).
Grind stigmas in DNA/RNA Shield solution for 2 mins at full speed in a tissue homogenizer (e.g., Geno Grinder).
If foam forms on the surface, spin the Eppendorf tubes at maximum speed for approx. 1 min in the centrifuge.

steps.title: Lysis and Nucleoprotein Dissociation
steps.instruction: Lyse the samples using TRIzol reagent.

substeps.instruction: Add 800 μL of TRIzol reagent (kept at 4 °C).
Mix samples by gentle inversion or rocking motion for 2-3 minutes at RT.
Incubate the lysate at RT for 5 min to allow complete dissociation of nucleoprotein complexes.

steps.title: Initial Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate to separate components.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 15,000 rpm (no more than 12,000x g) for 10 mins at 4 °C.

steps.title: Phase Separation with Chloroform
steps.instruction: Separate the RNA-containing aqueous phase using chloroform.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant into a fresh 1.5 mL tube.
Add 0.2 volumes of chloroform per volume of TRIzol (e.g., 160 μL per 800 μL of TRIzol).
Shake the tube vigorously by hand for 15 s.
Incubate for 2-3 min at RT.
Centrifuge at 15,000 rpm (no more than 12,000x g) for 10 mins at 4 °C.

steps.title: Aqueous Phase Recovery
steps.instruction: Recover the upper aqueous phase for RNA purification.

substeps.instruction: Carefully transfer the upper aqueous phase into a nuclease-free tube.
Perform all subsequent steps at room temperature and centrifugation at 10,000 – 16,000 x g for 30 seconds.

steps.title: RNA Precipitation and Binding
steps.instruction: Precipitate RNA and bind it to the Zymo-Spin column.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 volume of ethanol (95-100%) for each volume of the aqueous phase (as measured or estimated) and mix.
Transfer the sample to the Zymo-Spin™ IC Column in a Collection Tube and centrifuge.
Discard the flow-through. (Note: Zymo-Spin™ columns may be reloaded to process samples >800 μl).

steps.title: In-column DNase I Treatment
steps.instruction: Remove genomic DNA from the bound RNA.

substeps.instruction: Prewash the column with 400 μl RNA Wash Buffer, centrifuge, and discard the flow-through.
Prepare DNase I reaction mix in an RNase-free tube by mixing 5 μl DNase I and 35 μl DNA Digestion Buffer; mix well by gentle inversion.
Add 40 μl of the reaction mix directly to the column matrix.
Incubate at room temperature (20-30 ºC) for 15 minutes.

steps.title: RNA Column Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the bound RNA to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 μl RNA Prep Buffer to the column, centrifuge, and discard the flow-through.
Add 700 μl RNA Wash Buffer to the column, centrifuge, and discard the flow-through.
Add 400 μl RNA Wash Buffer to the column and centrifuge for 1 minute to ensure complete removal of the wash buffer.

steps.title: RNA Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the purified RNA from the column.

substeps.instruction: Carefully transfer the column into a nuclease-free tube.
Add 15 μl DNase/RNase-Free Water directly to the column matrix and centrifuge (alternatively, use ≥6 μl elution for highly concentrated RNA).

steps.title: Storage and Quality Control
steps.instruction: Store the RNA and assess its quality.

substeps.instruction: Use the eluted RNA immediately or store at -80 °C to prevent degradation (avoid multiple freeze-thaw cycles).
Quantify and assess RNA quality using a spectrophotometer (e.g., Nanodrop), agarose gel, or bioanalyzer.
